integrity: The infinite statement is proved analytically from the exact distance table. Exhaustive computation for \(3\le n\le9\) is used only as a finite verification layer and is not presented as an infinite proof. The scalar \(n=3\) case already follows from the published cycle formula and is not used as the originality basis.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to unweighted crown graphs with \(n\ge3\). The literature comparison cannot exclude a poorly indexed equivalent formulation under product-graph aliases; one later operation paper was assessed from its abstract and stated scope rather than checked full text.
title: Disjunctive-total-domination polynomial of crown graphs
